def: The product a person uses to type a query and read a ranked list of results.
Given a query, returning the most relevant items from a collection in ranked order.
Fetching relevant passages first and then asking a language model to write an answer from them, ideally with citations.
The failure where a query and a relevant document describe the same idea in different words, so word matching finds nothing.
The limit that retrieval puts on answer quality: if the right evidence is not retrieved, no generator can answer correctly.
Optical character recognition: turning an image of text into characters.
